scope: Offline runtime record initialization and iBoot frequency metadata; not early hardware policy

findings.initial_record: 37 instruction words in six spans match disassembly/collection bytes; count * 0x118 bytes cleared through resolved _bzero; selected record attached at CPUComplex+0x50, consumer reads record+0xf
findings.frequency_export: 105 instruction words across three spans match raw iBoot; six selector/property pairs and returned-value helper checked
findings.inherited_state: Patched kernel payload rejects T6032 cpufreq failure before SMP; hv_init has no cpufreq call. Neither proves electrical initialization requirements.

limitations: Initial software zero does not establish the first dynamically consumed state or any raw APSC/default index.
No exhaustive alias, subsequent-write or concurrency proof.
Frequency-property metadata is not a proven early register-programming policy; downstream callees are not claimed free of MMIO.
Inspection wrappers and resolved authenticated fixups are offline evidence, not live pointer authentication or execution.
Local scratch verifiers, reports and captured binaries are not distributed in this commit.
